name: Dataset crate (crate-kit)
postCreateCommand: conda env create -f environment.yml || conda env update -f environment.yml; grep -q 'conda activate crate-kit' ~/.bashrc || echo 'conda activate crate-kit' >> ~/.bashrc
postAttachCommand:
echo '
  Dataset crate ready. Try:
    crate build .      # scan the repo into the crate
    crate enrich .     # resolve ORCIDs / DOIs
    crate validate .   # check it
    crate render . -o _site
'
